rules.description: A schedule has a finite non-empty validity interval, so it cannot be born stale. Canon requires schedules to enter as EXPIRING advisory evidence where a stale schedule is a typed gap rather than a silently aged number; a record whose expiry does not follow its observation could never become that typed gap, because it was never fresh.
A schedule prices at least one dimension. An empty schedule would rank a route at zero cost, which is the exact shape of reading an absence as a number.
